262:
SELECT
    p."title" AS position_title,
    sd."salary_range" AS compensation_range,
    sd."hourly_rate" AS hourly_rate
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
WHERE
    LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."description" AS position_description,
    STRING_AGG(rs."skillname", ', ' ORDER BY rs."skillname") AS required_skills,
    STRING_AGG(er."degreelevel" || ' in ' || er."fieldofstudy", ', ' ORDER BY er."degreelevel") AS education_requirements
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "jobskills" js ON j."jobid" = js."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" rs ON js."skillid" = rs."skillid"
LEFT JOIN
    "jobeducation" je ON j."jobid" = je."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" er ON je."requirementid" = er."requirementid"
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs" WHERE "jobid" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY
    j."jobid", j."minimum_years", j."preferred_years", j."jobtitle", j."description";
